lesson_text: DD 12/25 wide overlay on STR_1453 (SUE x NetDebt-EP) reduces MDD from 55.4% to 35.0% with minimal SR loss (1.005 -> 0.993). CAGR drops from 22.2% to 17.1% (still above 16% target). Confirms L-802: 12% trigger is better suited to Korean market volatility than 8% — brake active 25.6% of days vs excessive whipsaw at 8%. DD brake is effective at rescuing high-alpha/high-MDD strategies from hard fail. Grade B (score 66.1) due to axis scoring (Return 37, Risk 37), not hard fail. FMB t=7.09 confirms independent alpha. Condition: works when parent has genuine alpha (FMB t>3) but excessive drawdown; does not create alpha from nothing.
core_reference: L-802 (DD 8% too tight for Korean market); QEPM section 10 (statistical defense); Grossman & Zhou (1993) optimal drawdown constraints
condition: DD 12/25 effective when parent strategy has FMB t>3 alpha but MDD>45%. Korean market volatility makes 8% trigger too sensitive.
